text: I adapt well to heat and cold all year round and rarely fall ill.
Even light activity leaves me exhausted and short of breath.
My hands and feet stay cold all year; I fear cold and prefer warmth.
My palms and soles often feel hot, with a dry mouth and poor sleep.
My body feels heavy with phlegm, and my stools stick to the toilet.
I get pimples easily, taste bitterness in my mouth, and have itchy skin.
My complexion is dull and I often feel unexplained stabbing pains.
I have long-term anxiety and low mood, with trouble falling asleep and vivid dreams.
Season changes bring allergic rhinitis — sneezing and a stuffy, runny nose.
I sleep soundly and my mood is calm; I am seldom irritable.
Wind and season changes give me colds easily, and I sweat when I move.
Under stress my chest feels tight and I sigh often.
